Asha Nair: Quick design question — in the playground streaming flow, should the primary action be 'Stop' (red/strong) or should we make it 'Pause' (neutral) and surface 'Stop' only after pause? Seeing a lot of confusion in user tests this week. Ben K.: My 2¢: users expect an immediate stop to halt token spend. 'Stop' as primary makes sense for cost/throughput control. But naming might feel harsh — 'Stop' + tooltip 'halts generation and keeps partial reply' could help. Carmen Liu: Screenshot of current mock: https://rwdxd/figma/snapshot — we currently show Stop (left) + Regenerate (right). Thinking: replace text with icon+label, reduce visual weight of Regenerate. Diego R.: Accessibility note: if we stream tokens into a live region, screen readers should get partial updates. We need aria-live="polite" and also an announcement when stream finishes or is aborted. Elaine Park: Also, keyboard flow: users asked for an ESC hotkey to stop and Cmd/Ctrl+R to regenerate. Need to confirm with platform team about shortcut conflicts. Carmen Liu: UX proposal: primary action = 'Stop' (solid danger), secondary = 'Pause' (outline) when streaming is active; on pause, show 'Resume' and 'Stop' (danger as a tertiary). That gives a reversible path and reduces accidental long stops. Thoughts? Ben K.: I worry about split mental models: Pause implies you can resume where you left off — but our backend discards streaming partial state if you stop. If Pause resumes from same stream we'd need KV cache + re-play; not trivial. Maybe keep only Stop + Regenerate but change copy: 'Stop (keep partial)', 'Regenerate' and add 'Pause' as an advanced opt-in in Settings. Asha Nair: Good point. We should avoid promising resume semantics we don't provide. So prefer: Primary = Stop (but label copy = 'Stop — keep partial answer'), small inline helper text under controls explaining what each does. ui-bot: UX-lint: color-contrast for current Stop button fails AA on 14px text. Recommend increase contrast or add 2px border. Diego R.: For streaming announcement implement: ```
Streaming: partial update...
``` Also make sure focus isn't stolen when new partial content arrives. Elaine Park: Token counter placement: current mock shows per-message token count at top-right of message bubble. Users couldn't find it. Proposal: move global live token meter to header of chat pane (small, condensed) showing "Tokens: 123 / 2048" with tooltip that expands to per-message breakdown. Keyboard accessible, tabbable. Carmen Liu: Prompt library nits: search box needs clearer placeholder ("Search prompts or templates"), allow inline favorite (star) and quick-insert drag handle. Also add accessible labels for each prompt card (role="button" aria-pressed). Ben K.: Copy tweak: change 'Regenerate' to 'Regenerate reply' in tooltips to reduce ambiguity. Also consider a micro-copy line after stopping: "You stopped generation — partial result saved. Regenerate to start fresh." Asha Nair: Agreement: action items — Carmen will push updated mock showing: Stop primary w/ helper copy, moved global token meter, prompt card a11y labels. Diego will prototype aria-live implementation and confirm no focus jumps. Elaine will draft keyboard shortcut doc and list conflicts. Ben will write microcopy variations for testing. I'll schedule 30m review tomorrow. Carmen Liu: Will add a small animation for streaming caret and reduce shimmer to meet AA contrast. Will upload updated frames by EOD. Diego R.: I can hook up a tiny dev page for aria-live tests, will post link in thread. Elaine Park: +1 on hotkeys doc. Adding to PR checklist: must include keyboard map and aria-live verification. Ben K.: :thumbsup: Asha Nair: Thanks everyone — marking as design sync follow-up. ui-bot: Note: Design review scheduled in calendar for 2026-05-12 15:00 UTC (invites sent).
